name: open.mp (Windows via Wine)
author: gambangsuep@gmail.com
description: open.mp server versi Windows (omp-server.exe) yang dijalankan di Linux memakai Wine.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip jq >/dev/null

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

REPO=https://api.github.com/repos/openmultiplayer/open.mp/releases
if [ "${OMP_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    API="${REPO}/latest"
else
    API="${REPO}/tags/${OMP_VERSION}"
fi

URL=$(curl -sSL "$API" | jq -r --arg a "$OMP_ASSET" '.assets[]? | select(.name==$a) | .browser_download_url')
if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
    echo "Asset '${OMP_ASSET}' tidak ditemukan di release '${OMP_VERSION}'."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Download: $URL"
curl -sSL -o /tmp/omp.zip "$URL"
mkdir -p /tmp/omp
unzip -q -o /tmp/omp.zip -d /tmp/omp

SRC=/tmp/omp
[ -d /tmp/omp/Server ] && SRC=/tmp/omp/Server
cp -a "$SRC"/. /mnt/server/

mkdir -p /mnt/server/{gamemodes,filterscripts,plugins,components,scriptfiles}
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null

ls -la /mnt/server/omp-server.exe || { echo "omp-server.exe tidak ada di arsip."; exit 1; }
echo "Instalasi selesai."
